author: Khaladi88
quote: The game is abhorrent and the writer are shameless towards their based customers. The meter fact that Rockstar & Take Two released this game on consoles and knowing the fact that it will even below 30 FPS goes to show how you scammed your whole base customers all for money. You should have at least made a better product first. Also your second biggest mistake was letting go of Dan Houser and gave him a bigger contract renewal. But instead you guys brought some of the most incompetent people to write this abomination of a story and plastered the name of Grand Theft Auto 6 on it. Good luck pulling back the people to buy your future games next time around. I know I won’t buy any of your products.
